# AI GIF Maker Prompts

Turn text into animated GIFs with AI GIF Maker. Native GIF generation — no video conversion. Type what you want and download your GIF in about a minute.

This package gives you instant Espanso text triggers for crisp looping GIF prompts, personalized greeting cards, Discord emoji reactions, and meme GIF concepts tailored for [AI GIF Maker](https://aigifmaker.ai/?utm_source=espanso&utm_medium=package).

### Installation

```bash
espanso install aigifmaker-gif-prompts
```

### Triggers

| Trigger | Expands to |
|---|---|
| `:gifloop` | Seamless 2-second loop prompt with clean contrast and centered motion |
| `:gifbday` | Personalized animated birthday cake GIF prompt with custom name text |
| `:gifemoji` | Compact Discord reaction emoji loop with crisp silhouette on solid backdrop |
| `:gifmeme` | Expressive reaction meme loop with bold caption framing |
| `:gifcyber` | Neon cyberpunk rain reflection looping badge animation |
| `:gifpixel` | 16-bit pixel art sprite idle animation loop |
| `:gifholiday` | Cozy seasonal greeting loop ready for name overlays |
| `:giftoast` | Minimal UI celebration confetti toast loop for docs and changelogs |
